WLClntId.description: WorldLink Client ID. WorldLink Client Number and Branch Number. Provide Branch number if the Branch Number was part of FX request
WLClntId.title: WLClntId

ContractRef.description: WorldLink Contract Reference number. WorldLink Contract Number and WorldLink Sequence Number - this is the true unique identifier.  External interfaces use contract number concatenated to sequence number to designate unique deals. Please use this if available.
ContractRef.title: ContractRef

UserId.description: Unique UserId created by WorldLink. It will be used as a key to reference the requests and accepts.  For successful deal lookup responses, UserId will be mandatorily populated by WorldLink.  In case the lookup fails or the Deal is not found in WorldLink, then UserId will not be populated in the response.
UserId.title: UserId

ResTime.description: Date and Time when the response is generated by WorldLink.  Format: "YYYY-MM-DD-HH:MM:SS"
ResTime.title: ResTime

BookDate.description: FX Booking date in WorldLink. If the deal is found the actual booking date is shared  Format: YYYYMMDD.
BookDate.title: BookDate

ValueDate.description: FX Contract Value Date Format: YYYYMMDD.
ValueDate.title: ValueDate

DealTs.description: Date and Time when the prebook deal was booked in OLR. Format: "YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.nnnnnn"
DealTs.title: DealTs

FundActTotalLmt.description: Total FX limit set-up by OLR - Funding account. This will only be populated if LinkToPymt is "N"
FundActTotalLmt.title: FundActTotalLmt

FundActAvlLmt.description: Total available limit - Funding account (Total limit - Limit earmarked). This will only be populated if LinkToPymt is "N"
FundActAvlLmt.title: FundActAvlLmt

FundActEarMrkLmt.description: Current limit earmarked - Funding account (Current earmarked limit + current drawdown amt). This will only be populated if LinkToPymt is "N"
FundActEarMrkLmt.title: FundActEarMrkLmt

FundActUtilLmt.description: Funding account - Current FX limit utilized post payment release (current utilized limit + receipt of infotelex). This will only be populated if LinkToPymt is "N"
FundActUtilLmt.title: FundActUtilLmt

PymtActTotalLmt.description: Total FX limit set-up by OLR - Payment account. This will only be populated if LinkToPymt is "N"
PymtActTotalLmt.title: PymtActTotalLmt

PymtActAvlLmt.description: Total available limit - Payment account. Total limit - Limit earmarked . This will only be populated if LinkToPymt is "N"
PymtActAvlLmt.title: PymtActAvlLmt

PymtActEarMrkLmt.description: Current limit earmarked - Payment account (Current earmarked limit + current drawdown amt). This will only be populated if LinkToPymt is "N"
PymtActEarMrkLmt.title: PymtActEarMrkLmt

PymtActUtilLmt.description: Payment account - Current FX limit utilized post payment release (current utilized limit + receipt of infotelex). This will only be populated if LinkToPymt is "N"
PymtActUtilLmt.title: PymtActUtilLmt

StatusCode.description: This parameter will be mandatorily sent in WorldLink response as per the following scenarios -  1. For successful execution WorldLink will return "000" 2. For any detail level error, a non-zero value is shown
StatusCode.title: StatusCode

StatusMsg.description: This parameter will be mandatorily sent in WorldLink response along with StatusCode. Message describing the error code/reason.
StatusMsg.title: StatusMsg
